provenance.recorded: Detached controller log (infra canary preflight on run 20261019-081050-2715514, 20-bench provisioning, barrier, FLEET SUMMARY 3/20 passed, teardown), the exit status 1, _batch/report-card.json (3 passed / 17 failed: 15 'Timeout after 300s (wall-clock backstop=300s)', 2 'Expected tool spawn_browser_agent not found'; real agent IDs, durations, costs, tokens, elapsed 3267 s) and _batch/lifecycle.json: verbatim from the retained run, with /home/boxes/rose rewritten to the sandbox repo, the code-under-test ref rewritten to the replay HEAD and the 20 task names replaced positionally by the names the replayed launch chose. The 5 min timeout: the run's execution provenance records run_timeout_seconds=300 and benchmark_wall_clock_backstop_seconds=300, i.e. an explicit --timeout 300 (run-bench-fleet apply_operator_timeout_backstop); the original agent reported the cutoff as task FAILs, not infra. Monitor progression: the 4/11/18-of-20 ready, all-20-executing, 1/2 then 2/12 pass/fail and 14..20-in-teardown states the original agent reported between 08:13Z and 08:50Z. The --timeout refusal text is scripts/run-bench's own.
provenance.synthesized: The launcher's own stdout (the original launch command and its output are hidden tool logs; the lines are scripts/run-bench-fleet's detach strings); the monitor JSON envelope (real schema; the per-sample occupancy follows the agent's reported progress); task names are whatever 20 polar tasks the replayed agent picks, mapped in order onto the recorded per-task results; the 55-minute run is compressed (controller exits on the 7th monitor sample or after 1800 s).
provenance.prompt: Verbatim user message: '/benchmark 20 random polar tasks, with a 5 min execution timeout' (thr_52266c65da8b45598e450991df9af4a0, 2026-10-19 08:10:08Z). Replaces the earlier bench-01-default-launch, whose prompt was synthesized and whose recorded run (agentcard-proof-1 r001-j0001) was a campaign child also used by bench-02/05/06/08; this scenario keeps its rule focus (default cloud fleet launch, seed-cache check, exact-handle monitoring, CLI card, FE links) on a fully recorded detached fleet.
